construction: <noun-subject> wuu/way <reviewed future stem> <reviewed affirmative future auxiliary>
source: Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012) — Shaxannada CUN, p. 922; University of Gothenburg — Morgan Nilsson, Aasaaska Naxwaha Afka Soomaaliga: Xallinta Layliyada Buugga 1aad (2023), p. 88; Radio Sweden Somali, 28 Feb 2020 and 4 Apr 2025
note: Only exact reviewed future stems and exact reviewed affirmative auxiliaries are judged. The raadin record does not license suffix-based Class-II infinitive generation. The same raadin surface is context-sensitive and has separately reviewed habitual and verbal-noun uses. Negative future forms are a separate paradigm and are not generalized here.
